voice.summary: Sounds like a shopkeeper who truly wants you to enjoy a good afternoon: excited but straightforward, and upfront that counts are simulated. No pressure beyond the clock.
dos: Say how many are left in plain numbers
Be transparent that the sale ends
donts: Never guilt a shopper for leaving

taglines: Up to 40 percent off, one afternoon
Good things, for a short time
Warm deals while the fire's lit
Grab it before the embers fade
boilerplate: Ember & Oak is a shop selling well-made home and outdoor goods, running an honest one-afternoon flash sale with real countdowns and a short cart hold.
